# Noria

> Noria is a browser-based studio for turning any location into custom,
> print-ready map art.

## Features

- Search for any city, region, landmark, or coordinate
- Choose a curated visual theme or edit map colors
- Style roads, water, parks, buildings, typography, and markers
- Export high-resolution PNG, PDF, or layered SVG files
- Works client-side without an account

## Data and source

Map data is provided by OpenStreetMap contributors and rendered with MapLibre.
Noria is derived from the open-source Terraink project and distributed under
the GNU AGPL-3.0 license. The original project is available at
https://github.com/yousifamanuel/terraink.
